Laxative abuse can result in laxative dependence, constipation, 
dehydration, and potentially renal damage.112 Patients with BN
generally have normal bone density.118
Eating Disorders Not Otherwise Speciﬁ ed
Patients who have atypical eating disorders or with disordered 
eating behaviors that fail to meet all the criteria for either AN or 
BN are categorized as having an eating disorder not otherwise 
speciﬁ ed (EDNOS), as outlined in Box 12.11.110, 112 A common
example of EDNOS is a female who meets all the criteria for AN 
but who still has regular menses or whose body weight has not
fallen below 85% of that expected for age and height. Another
example of EDNOS is the patient meeting all the diagnostic 
criteria for BN except that the binge eating and purging or other
compensatory weight loss behaviors occur at a frequency of less
than twice a week or for a duration of less than three months. 
Some individuals may engage in repeatedly chewing and then 
spitting out food rather than swallowing it.110, 111
